title: Skills - API for Anything
summary: Describe what you need in plain text, get a reusable API endpoint.
body_markdown:
Turn plain-text descriptions into production-ready API endpoints.


1. **Create** – describe your automation goal
2. **Analyse** – auto-generated parameter & output schemas
3. **Run** – execute via API with typed inputs


Create via[Dashboard](https://cloud.browser-use.com/skills) or[API](https://docs.cloud.browser-use.com/concepts/skills#via-api) .[Full docs](https://docs.cloud.browser-use.com/concepts/skills) .
